mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE > 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two quarters signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDPC1 declines for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5% over three months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS > 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 6% over three months signals robust labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS > 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 2% over three months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO < 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 4% over two quarters signals strengthening demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when GDPC1 > 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE > 6% (t-test p > 0.05).
